label: owns
definition: Person or organization X owns organization or asset Y.
scope_notes: Own, owner, parent, company-of and acquisition paths collectively form the largest coherent ownership component, preserving the prior ownership direction. Birthplace is a prominent competing component with the two highest individual path counts; it is not unioned with ownership. Location of premises alone is insufficient and proposed/rejected acquisitions alone would be ambiguous.

facts.reason: Peter S. Kalikow is explicitly owner of and owns The New York Post; publisher and acquisition are additional relationships.
Sotheby has headquarters and salesrooms on York Avenue; even the buy path locates an omitted purchased item on the avenue rather than establishing ownership of York Avenue.
Texas Air Corporation explicitly owns Eastern and is its parent; a rejected-acquisition path does not erase the independent direct ownership descriptions.
Danny Meyer is explicitly owner of, owns and co-owns Union Square Cafe; the management-list path is additional.
Mr. Keene is born in Berkeley, which is a birthplace relation rather than ownership.
